messages:
zane_ops: thanks for the infra deep-dive today! quick follow-up Qs about rollout/warm-pools/backfill :wave:
zane_ops: 1) what exactly does a reserved slot protect (hardware vs allocation seat)? 2) if warm pools run out, what order do fallbacks run in and what should customers expect for p99?

mira_infra: short: reservation holds an allocation seat + warm-pool reservation for the chosen region. it does not move physical racks until fulfillment, but it guarantees allocation priority when inventory arrives.

mira_infra: fallback order: 1) use local preemptible capacity, 2) switch to quantized/smaller model variant, 3) cross-region backfill (only if customer opted in). For latency-sensitive traffic we prefer model-variant fallback over cross-region routing.

cale_sre: ops note: default min_warm_instances = 2 per-AZ for small clusters; warm-pool hit-rate is tracked in the console. During canary we'll run 3x and 6x spike smoke tests. Rollback if cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m or p99 increases > 500ms.

nora_product: product asks: can we show a checkbox on signup: "Allow cross-region backfill if local capacity unavailable" with a tooltip about latency/billing? AE wants this for sales conversations.

mira_infra: yes, UI will include checkbox + ETA badge. billing note: burst charges are metered where compute runs; cross-region bursts will show as burst usage in that region on the invoice.

sysbot: [deploy] autoscaler-canary scheduled: 2026-12-20T02:00Z -> target 10% Dedicated clusters. Monitors: autoscale_events, p99_latency, cold_start_rate.

cale_sre: sample policy teams can use to simulate locally:
````yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  burst_local_pct: 25
  fallback_preference: [preemptible, quantized, cross_region]
  cold_start_grace_ms: 120
````

zane_ops: perfect. two final asks: 1) one-pager + public FAQ for signup + reservation modal by Friday? 2) internal inventory dashboard access for AEs?

mira_infra: will produce FAQ + one-pager by Friday EOD. internal read-only inventory dashboard for AEs will be available next week; will post link here when ready.

maya_ceo: great, emphasize phased APAC timing and default warm-pool sizes in the docs so we reduce surprise. :thumbsup:

zane_ops: thanks all 44d. ping here when docs/links are live and I'll update the all-hands notes.
